rows.name: Best hit rate achievable by a coin flip
rows.meaning: A coin flip repeats to wildly different rates across draws. Any single strong season is uninformative without this band.

rows.name: Shuffled-outcome placebo for S1
rows.meaning: Probability that random labelling of the same bets reaches the observed hit rate. p above 0.05 means luck cannot be excluded.

rows.name: Decisions needed to detect a 55% edge at 80% power
rows.meaning: Below this sample size a genuine 55% edge will usually be dismissed as noise, and a much smaller lucky run will look like an edge.

rows.name: Chance of at least one p<0.05 result in 10 independent looks
rows.meaning: Why the leaderboard needs a family-wise correction (G4).

rows.name: Chance of at least one p<0.05 result in 50 independent looks
rows.meaning: Why the leaderboard needs a family-wise correction (G4).
